case_name: Ritesh Sinha v. State of U.P. (2019) 8 SCC 1
summary: The Supreme Court held that a Magistrate can direct an accused to give a voice sample for comparison during investigation, without this violating Article 20(3) (right against self-incrimination). SIGNIFICANCE: Relevant in cases where WhatsApp audio, phone calls, or recorded threats are key evidence. Police can be asked to obtain voice samples.
ratio: Magistrate can order voice sample collection from accused. Does not violate Article 20(3).
